name: Hit
lead: What `players.on_click` hands its callback: the button, the slot, and the player, entity, block and face the click met.

fields.name: button
fields.description: "left" is an attack or swing, "right" is an interact or use.

fields.name: player
fields.description: Another player, when that is what was clicked.

fields.name: entity
fields.description: The thing clicked, as the handle the script holds for it.

fields.name: entity_id
fields.description: Its raw entity id, which is all there is for something the engine made itself, such as one of a screen's own frames.

fields.name: block
fields.description: The block, when the click hit one.

fields.name: face
fields.description: The face of the block that was clicked.

title: Hit type
